links.outcome: Image generation quality across gender, race, and ethnicity subgroups
links.effect: Stable Diffusion evaluations showed substantial disparities across gender, race, and ethnicity; no numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluations of the Stable Diffusion model reveal substantial disparities across gender, race, and ethnicity.

links.outcome: Effect of the FairDiffusion bias mitigation on image quality and clinical feature alignment
links.effect: FairDiffusion improved both image quality and semantic alignment of clinical features; no numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: To reduce these biases, we propose FairDiffusion, an equity-aware latent diffusion model that improves both image quality and the semantic alignment of clinical features.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of demographic bias in medical text-to-image diffusion models, presenting an equity-aware model architecture (FairDiffusion) evaluated on benchmark datasets (HAM10000, CheXpert).
